value.rationale: Generator count is a natural presentation/deformation invariant not recoverable from the unrefined Hilbert series. The exact family-wide two-variable formula and sharp maximal-generator generating product reveal a nontrivial extremal stratum and an essential fat-node correction, in a family whose all-motive unrefined series has just been solved. A direct geometric use of the exact data is to measure Euler-weighted complexity of the punctual ideal moduli by minimal presentation size; no downstream theorem is asserted.
